title.zh: 链上分析师将 Robinhood Chain 上 1840 万美元的 memecoin 抽资行为关联到同一起 rug-pull 操作
title.en: Onchain analyst links $18.4 million in Robinhood Chain memecoin extractions to single rug-pull operation

current_state.zh:
一位链上分析师根据链上数据，将 Robinhood Chain 上 10 个 Pons V2 memecoin 发行项目中约 1840 万美元的抽资金额关联到同一起 rug-pull 操作。这些项目的创建者将一组钱包列入 Pons 反狙击税的豁免范围，这些钱包随后买下每个代币的大部分供应量并抛售。

根据链上数据，该操作从受影响的发行项目中抽走了约 1840 万美元的价值，被列入豁免名单的钱包在抛售前吃下了每个代币的大部分供应量。Pons 用于抑制狙击行为的反狙击税，正是由发行这些代币的创建者本人豁免的。

据 The Block 报道，这些项目由链上分析师 Wazz 标记，链上数据显示，获得免税待遇的钱包在不到一秒内就买空了每个发行项目。该分析覆盖 10 个 Pons V2 发行项目，上述报道中具体指认了其中 9 个。
current_state.en: An onchain analyst tied approximately $18.4 million in extracted value across 10 Pons V2 memecoin launches on Robinhood Chain to a single rug-pull operation, in which the launch creators whitelisted wallets from the tokens' anti-sniping tax so those wallets could buy up most of each supply before dumping.

updates.detailed_summary_en: An onchain analyst tied approximately $18.4 million in extracted value across 10 Pons V2 memecoin launches on Robinhood Chain to a single rug-pull operation, in which the launch creators whitelisted wallets from the tokens' anti-sniping tax so those wallets could buy up most of each supply before dumping.
updates.background_zh: Pons 是 Robinhood Chain 上的一个发行平台：创建者部署固定供应量的代币，公众沿联合曲线（bonding curve）买入，当曲线被买满后，该发行项目会进入一个流动性被永久锁定的 Uniswap v4 资金池。Pons 于 2026 年 7 月 13 日上线，距 Robinhood Chain 公开主网仅 12 天；后者是由 Robinhood 打造的无需许可、兼容以太坊的 Layer 2，面向链上金融基础设施和现实世界资产。该链上线第一周内就出现了 memecoin 交易。
updates.background_en: Pons is a launchpad on Robinhood Chain where a creator deploys a fixed-supply token, the public buys it along a bonding curve, and the launch graduates into a Uniswap v4 pool whose liquidity is locked permanently. Pons launched on July 13, 2026, twelve days after Robinhood Chain's public mainnet — a permissionless, Ethereum-compatible Layer 2 built by Robinhood for onchain financial infrastructure and real-world assets. Memecoin trading emerged on the chain within its first week.
updates.market_impact_zh: 损失落在 Robinhood Chain 上这 10 个 Pons V2 代币的买家身上，并会影响交易者对该链上发行平台风险以及反狙击税机制的评估。影响是否扩散，取决于市场把这些发行项目视为创建者单方面的孤立滥用行为，还是视作对 Pons 发行模式的信号。
updates.market_impact_en: The losses sit with buyers of the 10 Pons V2 tokens on Robinhood Chain and feed into how traders assess launchpad risk and anti-sniping tax designs on that chain. Any broader effect depends on whether these launches are treated as an isolated case of creator-side abuse or as a signal about the Pons launch model.
